name: The market by S. Domingos Church, Macau
summary: The market by the railings of S. Domingos Church (just out of view on the right) is depicted with its vendors, purchasers and diners; one figure holds up a sunshade.  Produce can be seen hanging beneath the awnings behind the market.  For the church of S. Domingos see E.2098-1921.
